:::{#exm-hat-matrix-projection}
#### The intercept-only hat matrix is a projection

For $\matr{H} = \begin{bmatrix} 0.5 & 0.5 \\ 0.5 & 0.5 \end{bmatrix}$
from @exm-hat-matrix,
$\tp{\matr{H}} = \matr{H}$, and

$$
\begin{aligned}
\matr{H}^2
&= \begin{bmatrix} 0.5 \cd 0.5 + 0.5 \cd 0.5 & 0.5 \cd 0.5 + 0.5 \cd 0.5 \\ 0.5 \cd 0.5 + 0.5 \cd 0.5 & 0.5 \cd 0.5 + 0.5 \cd 0.5 \end{bmatrix} \\
&= \begin{bmatrix} 0.5 & 0.5 \\ 0.5 & 0.5 \end{bmatrix} \\
&= \matr{H},
\end{aligned}
$$

as @thm-hat-matrix says.

:::
